description: A task created while filters exclude it disappears on close with no notice; focus falls back to New task. Same root cause as F-064-02.
expected: 'Created "Leave balance…" — hidden by Status: Review, Assigned to: Maya. Show it' with a one-click filter clear.
actual: Filtered board unchanged; only 'Saved locally · synced' in the live region.
suggested_fix: Show a dismissible hidden-by-filters notice (shared with F-064-02).

description: At 1280×800 the 680 px New task panel covers the whole filter row and 420 px of the 760 px single filtered column, so the active filters are not visible while composing a task they will hide.
expected: Filters stay visible (or are summarized in the panel) while creating.
actual: Filter selects hidden under the panel; column mostly covered.
suggested_fix: When a Status filter collapses the board to one column, left-align the column next to the panel, or show 'Board filtered: …' inside the New task panel.

description: There is no 'Clear filters' control or filtered badge; restoring the full board takes two separate select resets.
expected: A single 'Clear filters' action when any board filter is active.
suggested_fix: Add 'Clear filters' next to the filter selects when any is non-default.
